items.description: The six-setting model comparison is overly compressed

evidence_anchor.locator: Section 4.4, final paragraph, "Both models predict all six entropy-gap signs." and "However, M0 is closer to all three ChaCha20 entropy gaps; M1 is closer to all three Salsa20 gaps."
evidence_anchor.quote: However, M0 is closer to all three ChaCha20 entropy gaps; M1 is closer to all three Salsa20 gaps.

items.competence_basis: direct inspection of the result paragraph and Figure 2.
items.suggested_action: Replace part of the numerical paragraph with a compact cipher-by-width comparison or clearly labelled triples of the existing observed/M0/M1 entropy gaps and spectrum errors. Preserve the reported model tradeoff; use existing results without new simulation or testing. Editorial obligation basis: Suggested for inspectability of the six-setting comparison; the source finding does not undermine the stated contribution.
items.verification_criteria: All six cipher-width settings expose the existing observed and predicted entropy gaps and spectrum errors, and retain that M0 is closer for the three ChaCha20 gaps while M1 is closer for the three Salsa20 gaps.

evidence_anchor.quote: A5/1 used 80 keys, four frames, 22 singleton masks and 114 output bits.

items.suggested_action: Condense the three ancillary-study paragraphs around initialization transients versus recurring block structure and the fact that quiet diagnostics do not establish security; retain the minimum numerical evidence and citations for those lessons. items.verification_criteria: The ancillary account directly supports those two stated lessons, retains their essential numerical evidence and citations, and avoids a second dense experimental narrative.

items.description: Durable access to the existing research package remains unresolved

evidence_anchor.quote: The package has not been publicly deposited and has no public DOI.

items.competence_basis: explicit availability statement and successful inspection of the supplied local scientific files.

cost_scope.locator: Existing version 0.20.0 code/data package and Data Availability Statement

items.suggested_action: Before publication, deposit the existing versioned package at a stable public location or state a durable access arrangement and its terms; update only the dataavailability declaration within B0062. Preserve the version, hashes, and reproduction-command linkage. A DOI is an option, not a verified venue requirement. Editorial obligation basis: Required before publication because review-stage local access does not supply later readers with a durable route to the research package.
items.verification_criteria: The Data Availability Statement supplies a durable route and any access terms for the specific versioned code/data package, retaining its version and integrity/reproduction references; an author assertion of a deposit alone is not evidence of access.

items.description: Add a plain-language interpretation of conditional affinity and rank

evidence_anchor.locator: Section 4.1, Equations (7)–(8) and their accompanying explanation, manuscript p. 6.

items.competence_basis: interpretation of finite-field linear maps for mathematically trained adjacent-field readers.
items.suggested_action: Insert a brief explanation after the rank/mean equations: with the other inputs fixed, XOR-affinity is a constant output offset plus a binary-linear combination, rank counts independent output-change directions generated by input bits, and mean changed-bit count measures a different property. Preserve the equations, proof, and conditional scope. Editorial obligation basis: Suggested to make the central rank-versus-mean example accessible across disciplines; the proof and central argument remain assessable in the source review.
items.verification_criteria: Adjacent-field readers are told the operational meanings of conditional XOR-affinity, rank, and mean singleton changed-bit count, including why equal means can accompany different ranks.

consensus_summary: CONSENSUS-4 applies only to the four non-DA reviewers' agreement on the contribution's appropriately local diagnostic scope (EIC S1-S2, R1 S3-S5, R2 S1/S6, R3 S2-S3). Each of the six revision findings is separately SINGLE-VERIFIER: EIC W1-W2, R1 W1-W3, and R3 W1. Silence from another role is neither corroboration nor disagreement. No conflict in existence, remedy, or severity was identified; DA recorded no Critical or Major issue. The decision comes solely from contract condition F5, not from this descriptive consensus label.
